item.title: Venus Williams returns to Indian Wells with wild card entry
item.description: American tennis veteran Venus Williams has received a wild card into the singles and doubles draw for the Indian Wells Open.

item.title: Delhi gets blast alert as Lashkar-e-Taiba plots revenge for Islamabad mosque explosion
item.description: According to reports, the Lashkar-e-Taiba is plotting an IED attack in Delhi following the mosque blast in Islamabad, Pakistan, on February 6. The latest target of the terror outfit is to allegedly avenge the suicide blast at the Islamabad mosque, that killed 31 people and injured more than 160.

item.title: Who is Neal Katyal, Indian-American lawyer who argued against Trump’s tariffs?
item.description: Neal Katyal, former Acting Solicitor General, successfully argued before the US Supreme Court to strike down Donald Trump’s sweeping tariffs imposed under emergency powers.

item.title: Nitin Nabin seeks blessings of Mahant Swami Maharaj during first Gujarat visit as BJP national president
item.description: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party Nitin Nabin paid a courtesy visit to Mahant Swami Maharaj at the revered Swaminarayan Akshardham in Gandhinagar.

item.title: Holi Kab Hai: March 3rd or 4th? Exact date for Dulhandi explained
item.description: Confused about Holi 2026 date? Find out whether Dulhandi will be celebrated on March 3 or March 4 and understand how tithi timings decide festivities.

item.title: BJP shows black flags to Rahul Gandhi in Mumbai, day after Congress workers shirtless protest at AI Summit
item.description: The Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi was on way to Thane, when the BJP workers tried to block his way. They showed black flags to the Congress leader. He arrived in Mumbai to appear in court in a 2014 case.

item.title: Shakira gifts free mega-concert to adoring Mexican fans THIS March
item.description: Colombian superstar Shakira announced a free concert at Mexico City’s Zócalo on March 1. After selling out 12 stadium shows, she said, “Beautiful Mexico! I want to return some of the love you have shown me.” Fans are thrilled.

item.title: Gurugram: 19-year-old woman allegedly confined and tortured by live-in partner, admitted to AIIMS Delhi
item.description: A Tripura student was hospitalised after allegedly being assaulted by her live-in partner in Gurugram; the accused has been arrested.

item.title: OpenAI is close to launching ChatGPT AI smart speaker; gives price range
item.description: OpenAI, is planning to bring a new smart speaker, along with other AI-powered hardware products in plans. Last year the brand had roped in Apple designer Jony Ive to lead the design team.

item.title: ‘He blatantly lied’: Bangladesh assistant coach slams former sports adviser Nazrul for T20 WC fiasco
item.description: Bangladesh assistant coach Mohammad Salahuddin has slammed former sports advisor Asif Nazrul alleging that he misrepresented facts regarding team’s participation in the T20 World Cup.
